pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Kapilavatthusmiṃ Nigrodhārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarena kumbhakārena bhikkhū pavāritā honti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.3: yesaṃ ayyānaṃ pattena attho ahaṃ pattenā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.4: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū na mattaṃ jānitvā bahū patte viññāpenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.5: yesaṃ khuddakā pattā te mahante patte viññāpenti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.6: yesaṃ mahantā pattā te khuddake patte viññāpenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.7: atha kho so kumbhakāro bhikkhūnaṃ bahū patte karonto na sakkoti aññaṃ vikkāyikaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ kātuṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.10: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā na mattaṃ jānitvā bahū patte viññāpessanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.11: ayaṃ imesaṃ bahū patte karonto na sakkoti aññaṃ vikkāyikaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ kātuṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.13: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.14: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te . . . vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.15: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhū na mattaṃ jānitvā bahū patte viññāpessantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.16: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.17: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū na mattaṃ jānitvā bahū patte viññāpentīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.20: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā na mattaṃ jānitvā bahū patte viññāpessanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.21: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.22: vigarahitvā dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.1.23: na bhikkhave patto viññāpetabbo. yo viññāpeyya, āpatti dukkaṭassā 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno patto bhinno hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.2.2: atha kho so bhikkhu bhagavatā paṭikkhittaṃ pattaṃ viññāpetun ti kukkuccāyanto na viññāpeti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.2.5: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā hatthesu piṇḍāya carissanti seyyathāpi titthiyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.2.6: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.2.7: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etaṃ atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.2.8: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.2.9: anujānāmi bhikkhave naṭṭhapattassa vā bhinnapattassa vā pattaṃ viññāpetun ti. ||2||
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavatā anuññātaṃ naṭṭhapattassa vā bhinnapattassa vā pattaṃ viññāpetun ti, te appamattakena pi bhinnena appamattakena pi khaṇḍena vilikhitamattena pi bahū patte viññāpenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.2: atha kho so kumbhakāro bhikkhūnaṃ tath' eva bahū patte karonto na sakkoti aññaṃ vikkāyikaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ kātuṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.5: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā na mattaṃ jānitvā bahū patte viññāpessanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.6: ayaṃ imesaṃ bahū patte karonto na sakkoti aññaṃ vikkāyikaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ kātuṃ, attanāpi na yāpeti, puttadārāpi 'ssa kilamantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.7: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.8: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te . . . vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.9: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū appamattakena pi bhinnena appamattakena pi khaṇḍena vilikhitamattena pi bahū patte viññāpessantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.10: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.11: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave appamattakena pi . . . bahū patte viññāpethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.14: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā appamattakena pi . . . bahū patte viññāpessatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.15: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--;
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.16: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.17.1: yo pana bhikkhu ūnapañcabandhanena pattena aññaṃ navaṃ pattaṃ cetāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.18: tena bhikkhunā so patto bhikkhuparisāya nissajjitabbo,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:1.3.19: yo ca tassā bhikkhuparisāya pattapariyanto so tassa bhikkhuno padātabbo ayaṃ te bhikkhu patto yāva bhedanāya dhāretabbo 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.6: abandhano vā ekabandhano vā dvibandhano vā tibandhano vā catubandhano vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.20: sace lāmakaṃ pattaṃ adhiṭṭheti mahagghaṃ pattaṃ gahessāmīti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.22: tena bhikkhunā saṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā vuḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.23: ayaṃ me bhante patto ūnapañcabandhanena pattena cetāpito nissaggiyo,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.27: pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgato bhikkhu pattagāhāpako sammannitabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.28: yo na chandāgatiṃ gaccheyya, na dosāgatiṃ gaccheyya, na mohāgatiṃ gaccheyya, na bhayāgatiṃ gaccheyya, gahitāgahitañ ca jāneyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.31: yācitvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṃgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.33: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ pattagāhāpakaṃ sammanneyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.37: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa bhikkhuno pattagāhāpakassa sammuti so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.45: sace thero gaṇhāti, therassa patto dutiyassa gāhetabbo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.46: na ca tassa anuddayatāya na gahetabbo. yo na gaṇheyya, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.48: eten' eva upāyena yāva saṃghanavakā gāhetabbo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.49: yo ca tassā bhikkhuparisāya pattapariyanto so tassa bhikkhuno padātabbo ayan te bhikkhu patto yāva bhedanāya dhāretabbo 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.50: tena bhikkhunā so patto na adese nikkhipitabbo na abhogena bhuñjitabbo na vissajjetabbo kathāyaṃ patto nasseyya vā vinasseyya vā bhijjeyya vā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.1.51: sace adese vā nikkhipati abhogena vā bhuñjati vissajjeti vā, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.2.1: abandhanena pattena abandhanaṃ pattaṃ cetāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.2.26: abandhanena pattena abandhanokāsaṃ pattaṃ cetāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np22:2.2.45: abandhanokāsena pattena abandhanaṃ pattaṃ cetāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ . . .
